北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京有霾，出门记得戴口罩，注意防护，呵护好自己哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Haze in Beijing, remember to wear a mask outdoors for protection.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪多云但体感 8℃ 稍凉，湿度高。记得添衣，保持舒适哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Cixi, feels cool at 8℃ with high humidity. Dress warmly and stay comfy.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海有雾，能见度低，早出行注意交通安全，小心慢行。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Fog in Shanghai, low visibility. Drive carefully and stay safe if you're out early.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州雾气浓，湿度 93% 略感潮湿。外出注意交通，保持好心情！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is foggy with high humidity. Watch out on the road, stay cheerful!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，气温 21℃ 适中。湿度 77%，注意通风，保持舒适。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Overcast in Shenzhen, mild 21℃. With 77% humidity, keep air circulating for comfort.
深圳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州雾气弥漫，体感 10℃ 较凉。出门注意交通，别着凉啦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Foggy Hangzhou, feels cool at 10℃. Drive safe and don't catch a cold.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，气温 11℃。虽有阳光，体感稍凉，记得保暖哟。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny Nanjing at 11℃. It's bright but feels a bit cool, so keep warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 11℃ 有些凉意。记得多穿点，注意保暖防寒。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Overcast Chengdu, feels cool at 11℃. Dress warmly to stay cozy and avoid the chill.
成都.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉有雾，能见度不高。出门多留心，体感 14℃ 蛮舒适的。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Fog in Wuhan, visibility low. Be extra careful outdoors, it feels pleasant at 14℃.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 12℃ 微凉，湿度 18% 偏低。多喝水润润喉哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Overcast Xi'an, feels cool at 12℃ with low 18% humidity. Remember to hydrate!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，体感 17℃ 舒适。风力 2级，出门逛逛也是不错的。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Overcast Chongqing, comfortable 17℃. A gentle breeze at level 2, great for a stroll.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨有霾且体感 0℃，非常寒冷。务必全副武装，注意防寒保暖！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Hazy and freezing 0℃ in Harbin. Bundle up well and stay extra warm!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳阴天，体感 8℃ 有些凉。记得加件外套，别着凉了呀。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Overcast Shenyang, feels cool at 8℃. Remember to grab a jacket and stay warm.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 16℃ 宜人。风力 3级，出门防风也要注意哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Kunming, pleasant 16℃. With 3-level wind, remember to shield from the breeze.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，体感 12℃ 稍凉，湿度 82% 偏高。注意穿衣，保持好心情。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy Xiamen, feels cool at 12℃ with high humidity. Dress wisely and stay cheerful.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，体感 5℃ 较冷，湿度 83%。出门加衣，注意安全哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Foggy Qingdao, cold at 5℃ with high humidity. Dress warmly and stay safe outdoors.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天，体感 6℃ 有些冷。多穿几层，暖暖和和过一天。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Overcast Dalian, feels cold at 6℃. Layer up and stay warm throughout the day.
